flags.ABSORB_ALIGNMENT_DIFF: set to 1 by the harness only

model_registry_note: None. No model is called anywhere in this experiment. The contract's Resources line allows an embedding provider for the semantic signal and this run does not use one: the content signals are lexical, numeric and structural. The consequence is recorded in the result block - the semantic ceiling here is lexical, and an embedding arm is unmeasured.
raw_evidence: raw/ is stored compressed; receipts/raw-evidence-manifest.json carries the raw and compressed digests and scripts/compress_raw.py --restore rebuilds the originals. Nothing was discarded.

seeds.fixture: sha256 over seed strings; no PRNG

split_definition: No train/test split. Every arm is deterministic and nothing is fitted, so there is nothing to hold out. No threshold or weight was chosen using this fixture; contract 0.9 is therefore not engaged and no holdout was spent.
